description: This file defines a Riverpod provider setup for managing quiz data in a Flutter application. It includes a provider for a mock quiz repository and a future provider that fetches quizzes associated with a selected lesson.

methods.name: _quizRepoProvider
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of MockQuizRepository for dependency injection.

methods.name: quizzesForSelectedLessonProvider
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches a list of Quiz objects for the currently selected lesson.
